entries.rebuildInstruction: In the German target company, open Fixed Asset G/L Journals read-only first, prove the German journal template and batch context, then proceed to Calculate Depreciation, Preview Posting and posting only after setup gates are proven.
entries.targetGermanCompanyImpact: German fixed asset depreciation screenshots must show German UI labels, German accounting setup, the depreciation journal line, Preview Posting and posted FA/G/L entries.

entries.rebuildInstruction: In the German target company, run Calculate Depreciation only after the fixed asset, depreciation book, journal template/batch and posting setup are proven. First prove the request page values, then confirm OK once, then verify whether a depreciation journal line is created before any Preview Posting or Post.
entries.targetGermanCompanyImpact: German final evidence must not rely on FA-291 as final proof. It must recreate the depreciation calculation with German UI labels and explain what should happen when OK creates or does not create a journal line.
entries.laborBoundary: FA-291 proved OK execution and a missing visible journal line in RM-DEMO only; no Preview Posting, no Post and no German final proof.

entries.rebuildInstruction: In the German target company, recreate the purchase order for the target vendor and item through the UI, prove Vendor Invoice No., Preview Posting, Receive/Invoice decision, posted purchase invoice, vendor ledger entries, G/L entries, VAT entries, item ledger entries and value entries with German UI screenshots.
entries.targetGermanCompanyImpact: German final P2P evidence must prove EUR, German VAT/pre-tax handling, German posting accounts, final screenshots and optionally payment/open-item settlement. RM-DEMO invoice 108219 remains a laboratory learning anchor only.
entries.laborBoundary: UAT-P2P-001 proved purchase order 106049 -> posted purchase invoice 108219 in RM-DEMO with USD and 0 percent tax; it does not prove German 19 percent VAT, German chart of accounts, German screenshots or P2P dimensions.

entries.rebuildInstruction: In the German target company, recreate the vendor payment through the UI Payment Journal only after the posted purchase invoice and open vendor ledger entry are proven. Capture Journal Check, Apply Entries, Posting dialog, posted payment, Vendor Ledger Entries, Detailed Vendor Ledger Entries, Bank Account Ledger Entries and G/L Entries. Then repeat the P2P-003-style read-only application check to prove the source invoice is closed with Remaining Amount 0,00 or Applied Entries 1, or document why it remains open.
entries.targetGermanCompanyImpact: German final P2P payment evidence must show German UI labels, EUR, German bank account/posting setup, German VAT context where relevant, open-item settlement and bank reconciliation path. RM-DEMO payment PAYP2P-108219 is a laboratory route only.
entries.laborBoundary: P2P-002 proved a UI-first vendor payment PAYP2P-108219 with ledger trace in RM-DEMO. P2P-003 later resolved the open application check as laboratory evidence. Neither case proves German bank, VAT, compliance or chart-of-accounts final state.

entries.rebuildInstruction: In the German target company, after posting the German vendor payment, reopen Vendor Ledger Entries for the source invoice and the payment, then open Detailed Vendor Ledger Entries. Prove Remaining Amount 0,00 or Applied Entries 1, application lines, any payment-discount effect, and the bank/G/L trace with German UI screenshots.
entries.targetGermanCompanyImpact: German final P2P payment evidence must include the invoice closure/application proof and explain payment discounts or residual amounts in the German accounting context.
entries.laborBoundary: P2P-003 is a read-only RM-DEMO laboratory proof. It performed no new payment, no posting, no Preview Posting, no setup change and no bank reconciliation.

rules: Do not convert labor-reference evidence into final German book claims.
For German final screenshots, recreate the process in the German target company.
Use old RM-DEMO evidence as route, blocker and helper learning only.
